subject.title: fix(gateway): count pending restarts toward maxRestartsPerHour budget

question: Should `maxRestartsPerHour` remain a strict `startChannel` call ceiling, or may a pending recovery make one unrecorded completion call beyond it?
rationale: The PR deliberately changes the observable semantics of an existing availability-control setting, and automated tests cannot determine the operator contract maintainers intend.

options.title: Allow one completion pass
options.body: Accept one unrecorded continuation beyond the numeric ceiling for a pending recovery that consumed the last slot, with explicit documentation and real runtime proof.

options.title: Keep a strict ceiling
options.body: Revise the accounting state machine so every restart call remains within `maxRestartsPerHour`, even if an admitted recovery must wait for rolling-window capacity.

recommendation.title: Allow one completion pass
recommendation.body: Accept one unrecorded continuation beyond the numeric ceiling for a pending recovery that consumed the last slot, with explicit documentation and real runtime proof.
